UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and synchronized workspace preferences.

themeMode.description: Preferred appearance mode including pastel palettes.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether job completion notifications are enabled.

autoCleanCache.description: Whether temporary processing files are automatically cleaned.

compactMode.description: Whether compact UI density mode is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FavoriteTool.title: FavoriteTool
FavoriteTool.description: A user-bookmarked utility tool from the Toolverse catalog.

toolId.description: Unique identifier of the tool in the catalog.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when bookmarked via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TaskHistoryItem.title: TaskHistoryItem
TaskHistoryItem.description: Metadata record of an executed tool operation without storing binary file contents.

inputSummary.description: Concise summary of input parameters or file count.

outputName.description: Generated output filename or result summary.

outputUri.description: Local file path or URI reference to generated artifact.

errorMessage.description: Optional diagnostic message if status is FAILED.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when task started via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when task updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DocumentDraft.title: DocumentDraft
DocumentDraft.description: User-saved CV, resume, career letter, or fillable form draft.

draftType.description: Type of career or document draft.

structuredData.description: Structured map of section fields for the CV, letter, or form.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when draft was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when draft was last saved via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user profile and synchronized settings.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{toolId}.description: Stores bookmarked tools for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/history/{taskId}.description: Stores processing task metadata history for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/drafts/{draftId}.description: Stores CV, career letter, and form drafts for each authenticated user.
